Fall Hazard. This DANGER PELIGRO sign from CGAP Safety reads: PRODUCTION TANK / FALL HAZARD / TANQUE DE PRODUCCIÓN / PELIGRO DE CAÍDA. Written for oil and gas producers and service companies.

Why this sign matters

Gives English and Spanish speaking crews the same rule for the production tank fall hazard in one sign, so nobody misses it because of language.

Where to post it

On or next to the production tank.

Who orders it

Field superintendents and HSE managers.
